title: Length of a paired bit-string encoding
statement: For any bit strings $x$ and $y$, encode them by writing every bit of $x$ twice, then the separator $01$, then $y$. The resulting string has length $2|x|+2+|y|$.
replaced:
For all bit strings $x$ and $y$, the pair encoding $\langle x, y\rangle$
(each bit of $x$ written twice, then the separator bits $0$ then $1$, then
$y$ verbatim) has length
$\abs{\langle x, y\rangle} = 2\abs{x} + 2 + \abs{y}$.
